name: Louisville
seo_title: Louisville Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 9 Events, 9 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Louisville, CO: Parade of Lights, free carriage rides, Small Business Saturday and the Superior Winter Festival.
lede: Louisville celebrates in a walkable historic downtown, with a Chamber Parade of Lights, free carriage rides behind Clydesdales and a skating rink on Front Street. Neighboring Superior folds in.
celebrates: Historic Downtown Louisville fills its holiday calendar with a Small Business Saturday, free horse-drawn carriage rides courtesy of the Louisville Downtown Business Association, Old Town Skate, and the Louisville Chamber Parade of Lights. Shops and restaurants stay open late for the parade, Santa makes appearances, and carolers sing through the streets. Superior, a smaller town next door, folds into this page with its downtown Winter Festival.
lastyear: In 2025 the Louisville Parade of Lights ran on Friday, December 5. The Louisville Historical Museum gave away free Holiday Treat Bags for children during the parade while supplies lasted, according to the city's December Museum News. The Louisville Historical Museum is part of the city's holiday season, and the 2026 parade again features Santa and complimentary hot chocolate, according to the downtown association.
facts: Louisville's downtown carriage rides are pulled by the Kodiak Ranch Clydesdales and are provided free by the Louisville Downtown Business Association and its sponsors. Pickup is on Front Street across from the skating rink, and carriages leave about every 20 minutes. Louisville Historical Museum, run by the city, also joins the holiday season with its own December programs.
trains: Louisville has no Christmas train of its own. Families usually head to the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden for its Polar Express train ride, or farther west to the Georgetown Loop Railroad's Santa's Lighted Forest. RTD's commuter rail line also serves the northwest metro, so check the RTD trip planner for a car-free ride to Union Station.

faq: When is the Louisville Parade of Lights in 2026?

The Louisville Chamber Parade of Lights is Friday, December 4, 2026, in historic downtown. The evening runs from 5:30 to 8 pm, with Santa, live music, hot chocolate and shopping, and the parade itself begins at 7 pm.
Are the Louisville carriage rides really free?

Yes. The Louisville Downtown Business Association lists the horse-drawn carriage rides as free, courtesy of the association and its sponsors. Rides leave from Front Street across from the skating rink about every 20 minutes on the dates listed on the event card.
Where can kids skate in Louisville?

Old Town Skate is the seasonal rink in downtown Louisville, near Front Street. The downtown association lists skating as part of Small Business Saturday on November 28. Skate fees are set by the rink, so check Old Town Skate's own page for prices and hours.
Is Superior part of this page?

Yes. Superior is a smaller town next to Louisville, so its 2026 Winter Festival on Saturday, December 12 is carded here. The festival offers Santa photos, live performances, hot chocolate and a community tree lighting in downtown Superior.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Louisville for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 9 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Free Horse-Drawn Carriage Rides in Downtown Louisville) through December 31 (Noon Year's Eve), with Small Business Saturday in Historic Downtown Louisville (November 28), Louisville Chamber Parade of Lights (December 4) and 2026 Winter Festival in Superior (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
